[[Vermilion City]] }} '''Start the Countdown, Starmie''' is the 298th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 31st chapter of the {{MangaArc|FireRed & LeafGreen}}. It is subtitled '''Escape from the Black Hole''' (Japanese: '''脱出のブラックホール ''' ''Black Hole Escape'') in the [[VIZ Media]] translation. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} [[Carr]] pilots the [[Team Rocket airship]] with the intent on killing everyone else on board. [[Sird]] and [[Orm]] try to get to the cockpit and stop Carr, but Orm slips and falls off into the trees below. The force knocks the airship's controller from {{adv|Red}}'s hands, which Sird takes with her {{p|Persian}}'s {{m|Thief}}. Sird uses the controller to deactivate the airship's stadium mode and states that she has to get control of the airship before Carr crashes it. Now safe, Red and {{adv|Mewtwo}} head towards the cockpit. Red takes {{adv|Deoxys|Organism No. 2}} with him, as he states that he can't leave it behind while it's injured. Red attempts to shake the door open, but Carr states that nothing he will do will get it open. Sird appears before Carr on a video phone, but he states that nothing she can do will be able to stop him. Suddenly, Sird's {{p|Starmie}} appears, having used {{m|Camouflage}} to disguise itself as a wall. Starmie knocks Carr and the pilot's seat off of its position. Sird tells Carr that she will not allow him to mess with {{adv|Giovanni}}'s reunion with his son. Carr praises Sird's tactics, but claims that he's better. A huge explosion rips a hole in the airship, sending Sird and one of Carr's {{p|Forretress}} flying out of it. Carr reveals that he planted ten other Forretress on the ship and commanded them all to use {{m|Explosion}} so that if the ship lands safely, it will still be blown up. Carr escapes from the airship on his {{p|Skarmory}} and flies off. Mewtwo breaks the door down and states that they have to get off the airship immediately. Red states that they can't, as the Forretress could severely damage a town or city if they crash and then blow it up. In addition to that, {{adv|Silver}} and Giovanni are still on board as well. Red asks Yellow to help him, but she begins dozing off from overusing her powers. Red realizes that this was Sird's intention when she told Yellow to use her powers on Organism No. 2. Mewtwo states that although it agrees with him, it asks Red what they should do. As it approaches [[Vermilion City]], the airship tips over. At the {{safari|Kanto}}, the [[Baoba|warden]] and [[Pidgebot]] watch as the ship flies above them. In Vermilion City, the people of the [[Pokémon Fan Club]] rush outside to see what's going on. At the docks, the {{tc|Sailor}} announces that they have arrived at Vermilion City. {{adv|Blue}} and [[Ultima]] quickly realize that the crashing airship is the one they were after. {{adv|Green}} asks [[Lorelei]] who's still on the ship. Using her tracking mist, Lorelei determines that Sird isn't on it. Blue tries calling Red on his [[Pokégear]], but gets no response. Blue and Green immediately rush after the airship in order to try and contain the damage. Back on the airship, Red states that he has a plan, but will need Organism No. 2's help. He has Organism No. 2 create a black hole to send Silver and Giovanni somewhere else. Once they're safe, he sends Yellow and Mewtwo into it as well. Mewtwo tries to stop him, but Red points out that the black hole is only an entrance to an exit. Mewtwo states that's not what it was talking about and asks what Red is planning to do. Red smiles and tells Yellow and Mewtwo that he will return safely as they continue to be engulfed. ==Major events== * [[Orm]] falls off the [[Team Rocket airship]]. * [[Sird]] manages to get the airship back to normal, but is later blown off. * Carr escapes and leaves the airship to explode with his {{p|Forretress}}. * {{adv|Blue}} and {{adv|Green}} rush to stop the airship from crashing. * {{adv|Red}} has {{adv|Deoxys|Organism No. 2}} send {{adv|Silver}}, {{adv|Giovanni}}, {{adv|Yellow}}, and {{adv|Mewtwo}} to safety. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Red}} * {{adv|Blue}} * {{adv|Green}} * {{adv|Yellow}} * {{adv|Silver}} * {{adv|Professor Oak}} * {{adv|Giovanni}} * [[Lorelei]] * [[Ultima]]/{{tt|Kimberly|Chuang Yi}} * [[Carr]] * [[Orm]] * [[Sird]] * [[Pokémon Fan Club Chairman]] * [[Baoba]] * {{tc|Sailor}} * Green's parents ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Sneasel}} ({{OP|Silver|Sneasel}}) * {{p|Deoxys}} ({{adv|Deoxys|Adventures}}; {{DL|Deoxys (Adventures)|Organism No. 2}}/{{tt|Entity Two|Chuang Yi}}; {{form|Deoxys|Defense Forme}}; {{adv|Giovanni}}'s) * {{p|Persian}} ([[Sird]]'s) * {{p|Starmie}} ([[Sird]]'s) * {{p|Forretress}} ([[Carr]]'s) * {{p|Caterpie}} (Trainer's) * {{p|Rattata}} (Trainer's) * {{p|Mewtwo}} ({{adv|Mewtwo|Adventures}}) ===Others=== * [[Pidgebot]] ==Trivia== ===Errors=== ==In other languages== {{Epilang|color={{colorschemelight|FRLG}}|bordercolor={{colorschemedark|FRLG}} |zh_yue={{tt|逃脫的黑洞|Escaped black hole}} |zh_cmn={{tt|逃離的黑洞|Escaped black hole}} (Taiwan)
